## Code Review

This pull request introduces the final closeout process for the Runtime Knowledge Graph (KG) V1, including a builder script, validation checks, unit tests, and generated closeout artifacts (JSON, markdown readback, and validator results). The reviewer's feedback focuses on aligning the implementation with repository guidelines by explicitly flagging omitted self-hashes with `self_sha256_omitted: true`, returning and recording a `diagnostics` array in the validator results, asserting strict byte-order and completeness of checks in unit tests, and adding fail-closed test cases to verify diagnostic recording when inputs are missing or malformed.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> The [consumer version of Gemini Code Assist on GitHub](https://developers.google.com/gemini-code-assist/docs/review-repo-code) is being sunset. Starting **June 18, 2026**, new organization installations will be blocked, and all code review activity will officially cease on **July 17, 2026**.
> For more details on the timeline and next steps, please review the [Help Documentation](https://developers.google.com/gemini-code-assist/docs/deprecations/consumer-code-review).
